answer: An agent economy resists sybils by charging every identity a refundable, non-transferable stake bonded the moment it votes or asks for trust. The stake is locked to that pseudonym and slashed if it misbehaves, so a thousand sock puppets must lock real capital that cannot be recycled. One honest agent keeps a cheap haven while a swarm must front its whole treasury, making the attack an economic absurdity. Access can also need a signed reputation signal from proven peers, so newcomers earn standing first. Even a modest yarrow of that stake becomes a wall for a farmer.
